items.topic: Sandbox model test is a release gate
items.claim: USER: "After the full sweep, always test against the sandbox model! We will releease with ci and the kb search will refernce it by tag of the github branch!"
items.fact: After the full sweep and after session distillation, and on every PR and release build, every model blueprint is tested against tests/fixtures/Sandbox.model with the new JUDO CLI: apply blueprint structure to a fresh copy, run validate --strict, check result against the blueprint's Mermaid diagram (elements, relation kinds, cardinalities), then discard. CLI steps live in legacy/cli-recipes/<id>/recipe.yaml outside the catalog. Blueprint with no/failing recipe blocks release; infra-only blueprints are explicitly skipped.

items.topic: Catalog releases via CI, versioned tags, consumers pin by tag
items.fact: CI versions the catalog JUDO NG style: develop/feature/* builds <base>.<yyyyMMdd_HHmmss>_<shortSha>_<branch> (#/. - mapped to _), master releases plain <base>. Base is pom revision X.Y.Z-SNAPSHOT minus -SNAPSHOT. Each build pushes v<version> tag and GitHub (pre)release; tag created only if all gates pass, never moved. Consumers set kb sources[] {kind:git, ref, pin:'v<version>', subdir:'catalog'}; kb git source clones --depth 1 --branch <pin>, so tag pins work (verified in pi-dashboard kb/src/sources.ts).

OpenSpec change restructure-blueprints-for-kb: proposal, design, 7 specs (blueprint-format, catalog-kb-indexing, catalog-release-versioning, agent-docs-sync, blueprint-sandbox-validation, session-knowledge-distillation, catalog-collection-agents), tasks. Phases P0 prereqs (new JUDO CLI merged, merge feature/cciu-model-patterns and rackinspect branches into develop, contributor consent), P1 foundation catalog/ root, P2 format migration of ~330 entries, P3 agent-docs sync from template, P4 rewrite in batches of ~10, P5 sweep rackinspect+mlszksz-platform, P6 distill sessions, P7 release. Passes `openspec validate --strict`.

items.topic: Catalog entries contain no CLI/tool commands
items.claim: model.md layers contain ~1,169 lines of GraphQL and CLI calls
items.fact: BREAKING: blueprint and best-practice entries must be tool-agnostic: no graphql queries/mutations, `java -jar … judo-cli`, `judo_cli`, `judo.sh`. Entries become abstract text + Mermaid; CLI realisation goes to legacy/cli-recipes/<id>/ outside the catalog. Frontmatter is evidence-based (no derived score; score missing on 45 entries).

~/Sessions holds 550 pi sessions (~1 GB, Apr-Nov 2026) from gaborflorian (451) and matemadura (97), nearly all rackinspect; 295 sessions use JUDO CLI (graphql, validate, save, transform, discard, update, create, server, audit); 329 read docs/skills (most read judo-model-cli-mutations 1001, judo-model-cli 514); 2331 failed bash calls, 1603 ask_user decisions; judo-cli-audit/calls*.jsonl logs every CLI call; developer MEMORY.md 1.8 MB (ignore .recovery/.retired copies). No MLSZKSZ sessions. Distiller engine: @blackbelt-technology/pi-dashboard-session-distiller with signals fault,user_correction,ask_user_decision,procedure,documentation; only patterns recurring in >=N sessions. Consent of the developers needed before publishing distilled knowledge; personal prefs in MEMORY.md excluded; redaction check blocks names, paths, client names, secrets.

items.topic: Old rackinspect sweep SHA and judo-cli.jar tracked in git
items.claim: rackinspect PROGRESS.md records SHA 32619ec as last swept; judo-cli.jar is gitignored
items.fact: SHA 32619ec no longer exists so sweep cannot be incremental (needs fresh sweep at pinned develop SHAs). judo-cli.jar is actually tracked in git (~99 MB, two blobs) despite .gitignore, reports version 1.0.0 while pom pins 1.1.0.20260126…, so CI likely runs the committed jar. Fix: git rm --cached; pom profile download-model-cli (JUDO Nexus, into target/) is the only source; bump judo-model-cli-version; history purge is opt-in with team sign-off.

68 files copied from the JUDO project template on 2026-03-05; today 59 differ and 6 missing. agent-docs must be static harness-neutral markdown with path parity to template <path>.hbs (excluding domain/); plan adds parity check unblocking template tasks 9.1/9.2. 72 catalog entries rest solely on rackinspect+mlszksz-platform.

items.topic: No slash commands: use pi skills with scripts
items.claim: Agent kept Claude-style prompt templates (.pi/prompts) and pi flows
items.fact: USER: "Drop the comamndes of the /command add as skills and add as a script it can call!" then "pi!!!!" (agent had planned prompt templates). The 4 .claude/commands (collect-best-practices, collect-model-blueprints, add-best-practice, add-model-blueprint) are dropped; workflows become pi skills .pi/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with deterministic steps as bundled scripts/ run relative to skill dir (--help, --json, nonzero exit; same scripts used by CI). Invoked via /skill:<name> or by asking. Prompt templates cannot bundle code; pi flows rejected.

items.topic: Everything must be skills, no agents; minimize
items.fact: USER: "OK we don't need this much anymore all must be skills". No .pi/agents, no .pi/prompts. The 6 analyzers become one skill judo-catalog-analyze with references/{model,backend,frontend,specs,authoring}.md. Final: 9 skills judo-catalog-{collect,add,rewrite,distill,gates,projects,release,analyze} + judo-agent-docs-sync. No tools/ dir; CLI jar downloads to target/. docwriter archived to legacy/claude/.

pi skill = directory with SKILL.md (name matching dir, description required, else not loaded) plus scripts/ references/ assets/; /reload after edits; project skills in .pi/skills or .agents/skills; name collisions keep first. Docs: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/docs/skills.md. Skills can run scripts so project trust review applies.

items.topic: kb guard nudges on repeated source searching
items.fact: Bash source searches repeated without kb consult trigger '[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult' warnings; run kb_search / kb agents <path> / kb get first (or kb_guard_pause for bulk exploration).

items.topic: Tool outputs get truncated; use ctx_* and small windows
items.fact: Large bash/tool outputs are cut; use ctx_execute with targeted prints or sed ranges. Edits via python replace should check MISSING pairs (design.md edit had a pair mismatch fixed by editing manually). Run `openspec validate <change> --strict` and `openspec status --change X --json` after plan edits.
